reason: Our last exam asked how we use AI, and I don't have a clean answer for agents trading on customer accounts. A free six-month design-partner slot that gives me exportable evidence and a kill switch is worth signing, but only in shadow mode first. No money moves this month, and the LOI price is where I'll push back.
objection: My engineers will say we can build caps, an approval queue and a kill switch ourselves in a quarter. I'm also not putting an unaudited startup with no SOC 2 and no customers inline on my live order path, and I don't know how many of our customers' agents even carry an AINRA passport.
would_change_my_mind: If they insisted on sitting inline on live orders before a SOC 2 report or an independent pen test, I'd walk.
